channel.title: SIREN: pillar spikes of 8+ points
channel.description: Any SIREN pillar moving 8+ points between consecutive readings, or going dark or coming back live. SIREN measures how much is happening, not how bad it is. Levels run from 5 (quietest) to 1 (loudest) and describe observable activity tempo against this index’s own record. They are not a probability of harm.
